raw_resume.summary: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering graduate (2025) with hands-on experience building full-stack web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and React. Seeking a Software Development Engineer II role to apply strong fundamentals in backend systems, APIs, and testing.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses. Integrated Razorpay test-mode payments with webhooks for created, captured and refunded states. Wrote 40 JUnit tests and containerised the app with Docker.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Developed a Java and Spring Boot service with a MySQL schema for booking study rooms; piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students and eliminated double bookings.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Built a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to track order status, deployed locally with Docker Compose.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain professional experience in distributed systems design and scalable backend architecture — the JD requires 2+ years of non-internship design and architecture work, which your current profile does not yet show.
Study and apply algorithms and design patterns in your projects; document your use of patterns (e.g., Factory, Observer, Repository) in project descriptions or a portfolio.
Participate in code reviews on open-source projects or contribute to repositories where you can demonstrate peer review practices and receive feedback on coding standards.
Build a project that explicitly addresses scalability, fault tolerance, or multi-service coordination to signal readiness for distributed systems work.
raw_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals, but the SDE II role requires 3+ years of professional experience and 2+ years of systems design — both significantly beyond your current profile. Consider applying for entry-level SDE I or graduate engineer roles first, then revisiting SDE II after 2-3 years of professional work.
